title: Decision: slicer, Bambu Connect hand-off and base
goal: How a print reaches the printer is written down
acceptance: Slicer command line and profiles, the Bambu Connect import link, which base has the app signed in, and why Developer Mode (LAN-only control and status) is or is not used
How the Tabgha service (no window) opens Bambu Connect in the owner's logged-in Windows session, and what happens when nobody is logged in
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
